simple.summary: חֲתֻנָּה (chăthunnâh) means a wedding First listed occurrence: Song 3 11.

definitions.full: H2861. chathunnah [ חֲתֻנָּה ] noun feminine marriage, wedding (Late Hebrew חִיתּוּן id. ; Aramaic חִיתּוּנָא id. ; Arabic marriage-alliance, marriage ) — only חֲתֻנָּתו בְּיוֺם Song 3:11 on the day of his marriage .
